questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They will decide the exact dates for the presidential poll in the upcoming meeting.
options_en: The exact dates for the presidential poll decided are being upcome by them in the meeting.
The exact dates for the presidential poll are decided by them in the upcoming meeting.
The exact dates for the presidential poll will have been decided by them in the upcoming meeting.
The exact dates for the presidential poll will be decided by them in the upcoming meeting.
questions.solution_en:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Future Indefinite. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the Future Indefinite.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + shall/will + V1 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + shall/will + be + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

He will complete the assignment. (Active Voice)

The assignment will be completed by him. (Passive Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d): The exact dates for the presidential poll will be decided by them in the upcoming meeting.

questions.q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order with the first part being fixed. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

In anticipation of the flooding,

B. To assess the potential and

C. An enormous amount of research was undertaken

D. Communities were relocated, and

E. Then the actual impact
questions.solution_en:
The correct order to form a meaningful sentence is DCBE. Part D comes first as it describes an action taken in anticipation of the flooding - communities were relocated. Part C continues the discussion by describing another action taken - research was undertaken. Part B provides the purpose of the research - assessing the potential (Accordingly, CB forms a logical pair). Part E provides another the purpose of the research - assessing both the potential and the actual impact. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: In anticipation of the flooding, communities were relocated, and an enormous amount of research was undertaken to assess the potential and then the actual impact.

Directions [Set of 4 Questions]:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Dog trainers typically describe their training methods on their websites. The scientists analysed these training philosophies to identify the words and phrases used by trainers to indicate different methods. Because 56 percent were ambiguous, they also looked at the tools used and at reviews. They classified the trainers as non-aversive (i.e., reward-based) or aversive. 55 percent of the trainers were classed as aversive, meaning they used aversive methods at least some of the time. The results showed that some words or phrases were pretty much only used by one kind of trainer, and never or rarely by the other. The exception was sometimes when a non-aversive trainer mentioned that they did not use a particular method. Aversive trainers sometimes described a "balanced approach" while non-aversive trainers wrote about positive reinforcement. Some words were used by both types of trainers but in different ways; for example, when aversive trainers referred to "tools" they meant concrete things like shock collars, whereas non-aversive trainers more often used this word to describe skills or knowledge that the dog's guardian would develop. Some phrases seem to always indicate an aversive trainer: electronic or e-collar, pack leader, and mother nature. And phrases that indicated a non-aversive trainer were shock collar (as in, they don't use them) and science. The words "electronic" and "shock" give different impressions of the same device.

What is the theme of the passage?
questions.solution_en:
From the following sentences from the passage, 'Dog trainers typically describe their training methods on their websites. The scientists analysed these training philosophies to identify the words and phrases used by trainers to indicate different methods', it can be noted that the passage talks about the methods incorporated by various dog trainers and how dog trainers are classified based on those types of training. Accordingly, the theme can be inferred as option (b), 'Types of dog trainers'.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

Has Gita any previous knowledge of work with junior colleagues?
questions.solution_en:
When prepositions ['of' in the given sentence] are followed by the verb, the verb should in present participle [-ing] form.

So, 'work' should be replaced with 'working'.

'Work' acts as a noun as well, but in the given sentence it is a verb as previous knowledge of an action of working with the junior colleagues is being discussed.

Hence, option (d) is the answer.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

Parts of a sentence are given below. While the first and the last parts (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the parts in between are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence.

S1) A fasting glucose tolerance test

A) from an impairment of sugar metabolism,

B) about decreased tolerance to sugar

C) in persons suffering

D) can convey important information

S6) such as diabetes mellitus.
questions.solution_en:
The correct order to form a coherent paragraph/sentence is DBCA. S1 introduces the topic of the fasting glucose tolerance test. Part D follows the introduction of the test and emphasises the significance of the test by highlighting its ability to provide important information. Part B logically follows, explaining one of the key aspects evaluated during the test - decreased tolerance to sugar. Part C provides context by specifying that the test applies to individuals who are suffering from a certain condition. Part A follows part C as it names the condition (an impairment of sugar metabolism). Finally, S6 concludes the paragraph by giving an example of the condition that the fasting glucose tolerance test can detect - diabetes mellitus.

Part A ("from an impairment of sugar metabolism") and S6 ("such as diabetes mellitus") form a logical pair because they complement each other. Part A names a condition/health issue and S6 gives an example of that condition. In option (c), part A is placed at last to form a pair with S6. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The sentence formed is: A fasting glucose tolerance test can convey important information about decreased tolerance to sugar in persons suffering from an impairment of sugar metabolism, such as diabetes mellitus.

questions.q_en:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Mahesh said to Rita, "Don't play in the sun".
options_en: Mahesh advised Rita not to play in the sun
Mahesh told to Rita to not play in the sun
Mahesh ordered Rita that not play in the sun
Mahesh requested Rita that don't play in the sun
questions.solution_en:
Imperative Sentences sometimes begin with Negative Commands like "Don't".

The reporting verbs like "said/say", etc. are changed into "asked/ask", "told/tell", "advised/ advise" etc.

"Not + To + V1" is used in these sentences. For example, "don't go" should be changed to "not to go" in Indirect speech.

In this context, "Don't ......" changes into "not to ......".

For example:

My friend said to me, "Don't go to Kolkata." (Direct Speech)

My friend advised me not to go to Kolkata. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

'Said to' will be changed to 'advised'.

'Don't play' will be changed to 'not to play'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (a): Mahesh advised Rita not to play in the sun.

questions.q_en: Select the option with the correct use of present tense.
options_en: The process of photosynthesis in plants is converting light energy into chemical energy to fuel growth.
The process of photosynthesis in plants have converted light energy into chemical energy to fuel growth.
The process of photosynthesis in plants converts light energy into chemical energy to fuel their growth.
The process of photosynthesis in plants convert light energy into chemical energy to fuel their growth.
questions.solution_en:
The correct option is c).

This sentence correctly uses the simple present tense ("converts"). This tense is used to state general truths, scientific facts, and permanent realities. Photosynthesis is a constant, universal scientific process.

· Option (a): This uses the present continuous tense ("is converting"), which is for actions happening right now or temporary situations. A scientific fact is permanent, not temporary.

· Option (b): This uses the present perfect tense ("have converted"), which describes a past action with a present result. This is incorrect for a timeless process. It also has a subject-verb agreement error ("process" (subject) is singular, so it should be followed by the singular verb "has", not the plural verb "have").

· Option (d): This has a subject-verb agreement error. The singular subject "The process" requires the singular verb form "converts" (with an -s), not the plural verb "convert."

Note: Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: - "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

questions.q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. This model relies on complex global supply chains that can design, manufacture, and distribute new clothing styles to retail stores in just a matter of weeks.

B. In response to these widely publicized detrimental impacts, a growing consumer movement towards sustainable and slow fashion is now advocating for more mindful purchasing habits.

C. Fast fashion is a highly profitable business model in the modern clothing industry which is characterized by the rapid production of inexpensive, trendy garments.

D. Consequently, this relentless cycle of production and consumption leads to enormous textile waste, significant pollution, and often exploitative labour conditions in garment factories.
questions.solution_en:
The correct sequence is CADB. Sentence C is the ideal opening as it provides a clear definition of the central topic, "Fast fashion," and its core characteristics. Sentence A logically follows by explaining the mechanics of "This model" mentioned in C, detailing how its rapid production is achieved through complex supply chains. Sentence D then describes the negative consequences of "this relentless cycle" of production, outlining its environmental and social impacts. Finally, sentence B provides a concluding thought, presenting the "response to these detrimental impacts" (from D) and introducing the counter-movement of slow fashion.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.q_en:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.

A. An engineer found a brilliant solution for the complex problem they encountered yesterday.

B. The engineer found a brilliant solution to the complex problem they encountered yesterday.

C. A engineer found a brilliant solution of the complex problem they encountered yesterday.

D. The engineer found a brilliant solution of the complex problem they encountered yesterday.
questions.solution_en:
Sentence B correctly uses the collocation "solution to" and the article "an" appropriately. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

A & D- The phrase "solution for/of" is incorrect. The correct collocation is "solution to."

C- "A engineer" is grammatically incorrect as "a" is used before the noun starting with a consonant sound, but "engineer" starts with a vowel sound. So, it should be "an engineer."

Note: Definite and indefinite articles: In the English language, we have one definite article 'the'; it refers to or introduces, a particular, specific noun. 'An' and 'a' are indefinite articles; they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.

questions.q_en:
A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.

The doctor shall have examined ten patients by 10 O'clock.
options_en: Ten patients will have being examined by 10 O'clock by the doctor.
Examination of ten patients was being done by doctor by 10 O'clock
Ten patients will have been examined by 10 O'clock by the doctor.
Examination of ten patients shall have been done by the doctor by 10 O'clock
questions.solution_en:
The subject of active voice becomes the object in passive voice and vice-versa. Moreover, the subject and the object interchange their placements in the sentence in active and passive voices and third form of verb is used. Case of future perfect tense: In passive voice, we use “Object + will/shall + have + been + V3 + by + Subject.”

Among the given options, only option (c) follows the rules of passive voice. Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.q_en:
Select the right sentence.

The villagers told the Block Development Officer that the contractor had fooled them.
options_en: The villagers said to the Block Development Officer, "The contractor fooled us."
The villagers said to the Block Development Officer, "The contractor was fooling us."
The villagers said to the Block Development Officer, "The contractor will have fooled us."
The villagers said to the Block Development Officer, "The contractor fools us."
questions.solution_en:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Past Perfect Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech will be in Past Simple Tense.

Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object) will be converted into Past Simple (Subject + V2 + Object).

For example:

She said that Yusuf had sent her a letter. (Indirect Speech)

She said, "Yusuf sent me a letter." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

Indirect SpeechDirect Speech
told... thatsaid to
had fooled themFooled us

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

Note: There are two other cases where either the past perfect tense remains same for direct speech or past perfect tense changes to the present perfect tense. In such questions involving more than one case, we go with the options. Since options do not include the sentence in past perfect or present perfect tense, option (a) is the right answer.

questions.q_en:
Directions: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Drug addiction is the continued use of a particular drug (1)______ harmful consequences. Drug addiction not only affects an individual's health and relationship, but also (2)______ the society and the environment. Prevention of a particular list of drugs can be possible by (3)______ their sale without a prescription. Drug addicts should be given proper medical treatment and (4)______ facilities. Motivational and awareness camps should be organized to scale down the consumption (5)______ drugs.

Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
questions.solution_en:
It is mentioned in the latter part of the sentence that 'drug addicts should be given proper medical treatment' so in the methods of prevention 'restricting (limiting) sales' is the right way to cure this habit of drug addiction.

'Promoting (to increase)' talks in the contradiction of prevention.

'Conducting' and 'performing' (both means to act) are not related with the given context.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.q_en: Select the correct sentence in active voice from the following options.
options_en: A vibrant masterpiece is being painted on a large canvas by the artist.
A vibrant masterpiece was painted on a large canvas by the artist.
The artist painted a vibrant masterpiece on a large canvas.
A vibrant masterpiece was being painted on a large canvas by the artist.
questions.solution_en:
Option (c) is in active voice. The subject (the artist) performs the action (painted) directly on the object (a vibrant masterpiece). Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The rest of the options are in passive voice, indicating that the vibrant masterpiece is the recipient of the action rather than the artist performing the action.
